title: Qatar Company Profile
description: Country-specific company profile for Qatar. Qatar has a dual-registry structure: the onshore Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MoCI) Commercial Register keyed on the CR number (the authoritative onshore identifier; lookup-only, auth-gated, no open bulk/API), and the Qatar Financial Centre (QFC) Public Register keyed on the QFC Number (financial-centre firms; browser-public but ASP.NET postback-driven). Listed-company financials come from the Qatar Stock Exchange (QSE), keyed on the ticker symbol / ISIN (QA...) — browser-public but loaded via portlet AJAX with no clean open API. The national open-data portal (data.gov.qa) carries statistics, not a company register. Currency QAR; languages Arabic + English; dates Gregorian. Owners/partners/managers and approved individuals are personal data (Law No. 13 of 2016) — redact. No registry per-company values were captured; listed identity uses public-knowledge QSE symbols.

registration.description: At least one registry identifier. Onshore companies use the MoCI CR number; financial-centre firms use the QFC Number.

cr_number.description: Onshore Commercial Registration number (MoCI). Primary onshore id. Lookup-only / auth-gated.

qfc_number.description: QFC firm registration number (financial centre). Browser-public, postback-gated.

status_text.description: MoCI CR status (active/expired/cancelled) or QFCA licensing status.

date_of_registration.description: QFC date of registration / MoCI CR issue date (Gregorian).

address.description: Registered address (firm-level). Personal for individuals — redact those.

capital.description: Registered capital (QAR), from the auth-gated MoCI CR.

officers.description: Approved individuals (QFC) / owners-partners-manager (MoCI). PERSONAL DATA (Law No. 13 of 2016) — REDACT.

listing.description: Present only for QSE-listed companies (browser-public; AJAX).

financial_statements.description: Financial statements (QAR). Public via QSE for listed companies (AJAX-loaded); private financials not open.
